correctness.rationale: Essential inferences verified by independent replay and hand checks; proof vs computation distinguished. (1) Geometry Lemma G: PASS. Re-ran verify_geometry.py -> GEOMETRY_OK; separation dist(Fbar+,K-)>=1/2 by x1 gap and K_- normal bound x1<=-1/2 exact; caps/edges in Gamma_acc confirmed. (2) Linearized identity <f2,DL[h]f1>=int h grad u1.grad u2 with conormal correction: proof sketch correct (Green both directions, dropped boundary term cancels conormal term); standard and honestly labeled proved. (3) Gauge formula L_V=dV+dV^T-(divV)I symmetric trace -divV: PASS (re-ran CGO_ALGEBRA_OK; random-matrix check). (4) Gauge inclusion G subset ker via L_V:(p tensor q)=div W, W=(V.q)p+(V.p)q-(p.q)V: PASS as formal identity. Hand-verified: div W expands to p^T DV q + q^T DV p -(p.q)divV plus Hessian terms p^T Hess(u2)V + q^T Hess(u1)V minus grad(p.q).V which cancel by Hessian symmetry; harmonicity removes (V.q)Delta u terms; W|dO=0 when V|dO=0 (compact support) so integral vanishes. Monte Carlo replay re-ran -> GAUGE-KERNEL-MC_OK (pair integrals -0.0015, +0.00036 within 5e-3 MC tolerance, N=4e5). This is the easy gauge-invariance direction; proof is correct. (5) Null-vector/weight algebra: PASS (NULL-VECTOR_OK for 3 (tau,k) pairs; limiting weight {a,b}=0 from Hess phi=0 trivially correct). (6) Opposite-sign amplitude completion (plane+linear dim exactly 5, full rank 6 via quadratic escape ik(2tau^2-k^2)/8tau^3): COMPUTATIONALLY SUPPORTED, analytically plausible. Re-ran verify_amplitude_completion.py -> full=6 linear=5 on all 5 xi x 2 seeds; extended sweep by auditor to k=0.01..19.9 (10 magnitudes) holds uniformly. Independently verified cokernel n=(-iR/t,it/R,0,1,0,0) annihilates plane pairing (0j exactly) and random transport-constrained linear pairings (~1e-15) across k=0.5..5, and escape pairing equals formula and nonzero for k!=0. By rotation about e1 any xi perp e1 reduces to (0,0,k), so finite-magnitude sweep plus analytic escape formula covers the transverse cone up to the uncommitted sympy nullspace step. Tolerance-based Gaussian elimination (1e-9) without interval bounds and sympy derivation cited as interactive (WORKLOG not filed) mean the universal 'for every xi' quantifier rests on finite samples + symmetry argument rather than a closed proof, and same-sign trace bound <=e^{-tau/2} has no replay (verify_samesign.py checks only ranks/null condition; bound itself is elementary e^{tau x1}<=e^{-tau/2} on K_- for +tau factors only). Opposite-sign growing factor e^{-tau x1} limitation is honestly disclosed via open remainder (R). Tilt/shadow margins re-ran -> SHADOW_OK (0deg -0.501, 30deg -0.001, 45deg +0.258); 30-degree cap correct as stated. Modulus alpha=1/24 is explicitly conditional arithmetic (MODULUS-BALANCE_OK), not claimed as estimate. Overall: no false computation found; limitations honestly stated in DRAFT Sec 2c/6; residual universal-quantifier/interval gap is a presentation narrowness, not a falsification. Correctness PASSES as a certified symbol-level + proved-identity package.

originality.rationale: Union search (Exa general x3 forms + OpenAlex + Crossref + direct prior comparison) finds no record of the cell-specific amplitude-completion rank package. Nearest priors substantively compared and none implies the headline: (a) DSSF et al IMRN 2018 full-data linearized transversally-anisotropic injectivity (FBI/transversal singularities) - no partial vanishing CGOs on Omega\Gamma_acc, no ker=G for conductivity matrix on this finite cylinder; (b) Kenig-Salo APDE 2013 / KSU Annals 2007 / BU2002 partial-data Schrodinger/isotropic Carleman templates - scalar potential, not symmetric-matrix h up to flow gauge, no rank-6 completion or escape pairing; (c) DKN Forum Sigma 2020 nonuniqueness (Holder non-UCP counterexamples, concedes C^2 quotient) - proves nonlinear gauge invariance, not linearized symbol ranks or same-sign linear-6; (d) Foschiatti-Gaburro-Sincich 2021 restricted gamma-A stability and Ouhabaz JST 2018 milder version - different a priori class, no front-face rank package; (e) Lin-Nakamura-Zimmermann 2026 transversally-anisotropic Schrodinger partial-data (Crossref hit) - Schrodinger, not conductivity-system gauge ranks. No source records plane-wave rank <=4/=3 on-axis, opposite-sign linear-5/full-6 with cokernel/escape formula, same-sign linear-6, or 30-degree tilt cap for Omega={r<1,0<x3<1}, phi=x1, Gamma_acc=dO\K_-. Exa queries returned only irrelevant landscape/measure-data/MO hits, confirming absence. Failure modes tested: synonymous notation (linearized DN / Frechet derivative / Lie-derivative gauge), dual/complement encodings (conductivity vs Schrodinger, matrix vs potential), broader census (CTA/transversally-anisotropic partial-data theorems do not cover matrix ker or rank package as special case; restricting full-data to partial data weakens hypothesis so no implication), exact table/database (no official database records this rank datum), recomputation/corollary (escape pairing and rank counts are not corollaries of qualitative Carleman existence). Originality PASSES.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING assessed under ordinary value standard with no presumption; judged on strongest headline separately from honestly-disclosed open survey. The package consists of: (a) finite-matrix rank counts for a chosen CGO parametrization on one cell (plane<=4/=3, opposite linear 5/full 6, same-sign linear 6 over tested frequencies/seeds, 30-degree shadow arithmetic), plus (b) the easy-direction gauge inclusion G subset ker via standard div-W integration-by-parts. It does not close TARGET or FALLBACK (both admitted unmet) and supplies no PDE injectivity: without the missing boundary Carleman (C) and two-term-WKB remainder with K_- vanishing (R) plus quantitative axis leg, symbol ranks do not imply ker subset G, quotient estimate, or stability, as DRAFT Sec 2c concedes. (a) is an unexplained enumeration, not a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: ranks depend on arbitrary parametrization choices (test magnitudes, random seeds, 8 amplitude rows, tolerance 1e-9) rather than an intrinsic property; same-sign linear-6 has no analytic explanation (pure numerics); plane<=4 is immediate dimension counting (3 div-free rows + 1 plane row); 30-degree cap is elementary dot-product geometry; escape pairing ik(2tau^2-k^2)/8tau^3, while exact, is a 3x3 algebraic identity any worker on this route recomputes instantly with no demonstrated downstream citation need. It is not the protected kind of narrow datum (exact order/constant/witness/presentation of a canonical object motivated before computation that a future researcher must retrieve): a future quotient attempt cannot cite these sample ranks to impose gauge, benchmark invisibility, or attempt stability without redoing the analysis with (C)+(R). (b) is a textbook restatement: L_V formula and diffeomorphism-gauge invariance (hence linearized invariance) are standard in the anisotropic program; the div-W proof is a routine exercise, and only the trivial inclusion is shown. No new general theorem, no intrinsic invariant, no reusable lemma with standalone citation use; honest disclosure of incompleteness does not create value. Intrinsic low value / arbitrary-scope enumeration: must be REJECT, not repairable by bounded addition, since converting ranks into a PDE lemma requires constructing (C)+(R) and closing ker=G - a new research direction, not a bounded identity/motivation addition. Certification alone (8 OK replays) does not rescue an arbitrary parametrization-dependent number.
